newsitem.title: USA: PP&L orders halt to Susquehanna work.
newsitem.headline: PP&L orders halt to Susquehanna work.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co said it ordered a temporary halt to work being done by a contractor responsible for making components for a facility to store used fuel at the Susquehanna nuclear plant.
The PP&L Resources Inc subsidiary said the action was taken because of quality concerns identified at the unnamed contractor's out-of-state facilities.
The components have not been shipped to the power plant, the utility said.
The contractor is fabricating some components for a dry storage facility now under construction at Susquehanna.
The purpose of the facility is to provide additional storage until the federal government begins accepting used fuel from the nation's nuclear plants, PP&L said.
It noted the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission last week announced it had asked the contractor to supply information about its quality assurance program.
PP&L said its action at Susquehanna was taken as a result of the company's own reviews and is not related to the NRC action. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
